phase_prompt.summary: Cinematic sky with crystalline sun and swirling wind glyphs.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A cinematic, photorealistic sky scene at the heart of an ancient-tech city, where a crystalline sun glows with a lattice halo and emits prismatic rays, surrounded by swirling wind filaments carrying luminous glyphs across a horizon of metallic cloud armor; the scene is grounded in realism with tactile textures, volumetric haze, bioluminescent dust, and subtle light scattering, evoking industrial mysticism and ancient Ethiopian-Egyptian aesthetics.
